split_population: all registered independent family lineages are assigned before qualification; qualification failures remain in their assigned split and denominator

confirmatory.development_allocation: remaining families after the frozen calibration and final minima

underpowered_exploratory.residual_assignment: final; never opened unless every confirmatory gate passes

primary_final_gate: Open the independent primary final after the frozen family minima, terminal development/calibration pairs, passing 12-pair shakedown, and pre-final policy freeze. ACRE certification is required for ACRE deployment/scoring only, not for the primary effect or simple comparator final.
eligibility_roster_rule: All registered source candidates and their mapped independent family lineages are assigned before qualification. Performance-blind baseline/channels_last correctness-only qualification controls measurement eligibility but never changes family assignment or denominator. No timing-based exclusions or re-splitting are allowed.
